Change c0217. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XI.

Context before (unchanged): (none)

1818 text: "It is with considerable difficulty that I remember the original æra of my being: all the events of that period appear confused and indistinct.

1831 text: "It is with considerable difficulty that I remember the original era of my being: all the events of that period appear confused and indistinct.

Diff: " It is with considerable difficulty that I remember the original [-æra-] {+era+} of my being: all the events of that period appear confused and indistinct.

Context after (unchanged): A strange multiplicity of sensations seized me, and I saw, felt, heard, and smelt, at the same time; and it was, indeed, a long time before I learned to distinguish between the operations of my various senses.

result.rationale: The change from the ligature spelling 'æra' to 'era' is purely orthographic modernization; the word and meaning are identical, so it has no interpretive consequence.
